name_reason: Matches the fd2_run_*_menu sibling convention (fd2_run_buy_item_menu / fd2_run_sell_item_menu / fd2_run_equip_member_menu) for chapter-intro menu-runner functions; descriptive of the give/trade-item flow, no Ghidra address residue, void(void). Already compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (run_give_item_menu).
purpose: Chapter-intro menu action that gives/trades one item from a source party member's inventory to a target party member.
logic_summary: Infinite do/while loop. (1) Show chapter-speaker portrait + 'pick a source' dialog (text page 0x200), set visible_item_count = party_member_count, run fd2_party_roster_single_select_loop to pick the SOURCE member; Esc (-1) returns. (2) Build a compacted gap-free local 8-byte inv_list of the source's item ids, skipping slots whose flag byte (inventory_slots[slot*2]) has bit 0x80 set. (3) If the list is empty, set last_action_sprite_id_param = source.char_id+1, show the 'nothing to give' reject dialog (page 0x1FF) and loop back. (4) Reset cursor/scroll, open the sell-mode item panel (sell_mode=1 is layout-only) and run fd2_shop_menu_input_loop to pick the item; Esc loops back. (5) Show the 'give to whom?' informational dialog (page 0x1FE, not a yes/no confirm), then run the roster select again to pick the TARGET member; Esc loops back. (6) If the target already holds 8 items (fd2_count_usable_inventory_slots==8), set last_action_sprite_id_param = target.char_id+1 and show the per-chapter 'inventory full' reject dialog (data_fd2_dialog_shop_inventory_full_dialog_text_id_table[cursor_state]) and loop back; otherwise re-fetch the item id from the source slot (fd2_get_inventory_slot_item_id), remove it from the source (fd2_remove_inventory_slot_at), add it unequipped to the target (fd2_add_item_to_inventory), and recompute only the SOURCE's combat stats (fd2_recalculate_combat_stats). The shop cursor indexes the compacted display list but is reused directly as a raw slot index, which is correct because inventories are kept gap-free.

returns.semantics: No return value. The function loops internally and exits (returns) only when the source-member roster select is cancelled (sel == -1).

comment_original_issue: Both the src comment (file-header line and function block) and the Ghidra plate stated '1 caller / Sole caller: fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main', but the function actually has TWO callers: fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main @ 0x2E341 (give = default/else dispatch branch, cursor idx 3) and fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeC @ 0x3072F (give = cursor idx 1). Verified via get_function_callers / get_xrefs_to (exactly 2 unconditional calls) and by decompiling both callers. The Ghidra plate also labeled global 0x5412B as 'chapter_transition_state' whereas the live Ghidra global name is data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state.
